 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    width = len(grid[0])
    # A partial horizontal band is completed with the contrasting color shown
    # in the demonstration.
    for row in out:
        colors = set(row)
        if len(colors) == 2:
            foreground = next(c for c in colors if row.count(c) > width // 2)
            split = row.index(next(c for c in row if c != foreground))
            # The patterned segment begins at the left edge; fill its remainder.
            if all(c == foreground for c in row[:split]) and all(c != foreground for c in row[split:]):
                row[split:] = [1] * (width - split)
                break
    return out
